Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Trainer creates a new Draft course with metadata, accepting the suggested price tier.
column3: 1. Log in as a VERIFIED Trainer. 2. Open Trainer Dashboard > Create Course. 3. Enter title, description, upload a thumbnail, select up to 3 SkillTypes. 4. Leave the pre-filled suggested price (300k/500k/700k VND tier) as-is. 5. Save.
column4: The course is created with status=Draft; the thumbnail uploads to Cloudinary and its secure URL is stored; the pre-filled price tier is saved as entered.
column5: Trainer role, VERIFIED profile.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Trainer cannot select more than 3 SkillTypes for a course.
column3: 1. On the Create/Edit Course form, attempt to select a 4th SkillType after already selecting 3.
column4: The 4th selection is blocked in the UI (checkbox/limit reached), and if bypassed, the server rejects the save with a validation error enforcing the max-3 cap (BR-CRS-04).
column5: A Draft course with 3 SkillTypes already selected.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Trainer edits a Draft course's metadata and overrides the suggested price.
column3: 1. Open an existing Draft course. 2. Change the description and set a custom price different from the suggested tier. 3. Save.
column4: Changes persist; the custom price is accepted as entered (Trainer always has final say on price per FR-CRS-06), status remains Draft.
column5: A Draft course owned by the Trainer exists.

column4: All 3 Sections are created; after reordering, the new order_index is persisted and survives a page reload in the new order.
column5: Draft course exists.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Trainer adds Lessons within a Section and reorders them.

column5: A Section exists within a Draft course.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Trainer authors Lesson content using LessonBlocks (Text plus an inserted Video/PDF/Image block).
column3: 1. Open a Lesson's editor. 2. Add a Text block with content. 3. Add a Video block and pick a file to upload; observe the progress bar. 4. Save the Lesson.
column4: The Text block saves as entered; the Video block shows an "Uploading" state immediately then completes asynchronously, after which the Lesson references the Cloudinary URL; block order is preserved as authored.
column5: A Lesson exists within a Draft course.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: A LessonBlock media upload survives a dropped connection using the Retry option.
column3: 1. Start uploading a Video/PDF block to a Lesson. 2. Simulate a network interruption mid-upload (e.g. toggle airplane mode). 3. Restore connectivity and tap Retry.
column4: The already-entered Lesson content (Text blocks, metadata) is not lost during the interruption; Retry successfully completes the media upload without requiring the Trainer to redo the whole Lesson.
column5: A Lesson editor session is open with at least one Text block already entered.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Trainer attaches a Quiz to a Lesson using questions picked from their own Question Bank.

column4: The Quiz is created and linked to the Lesson with the selected question IDs; reopening the Lesson shows the same Quiz questions attached (Quiz questions remain reusable elsewhere, unlike Exam questions).
column5: Trainer has at least 3 questions already in their Question Bank; a Lesson exists.

column5: A Draft course ready to submit.
